newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance bond issue over-subscribed.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance bond issue over-subscribed.

text.p: India's Reliance Industries has raised more than two billion rupees through a bond issue, the Economic Times financial daily said on Sunday.
It said the one billion rupee issue was heavily over-subscribed and had received more than two billion rupees within 24 hours of opening.
The issue closes on Monday and the company is likely to retain all the bids it receives, the Economic Times said.
The bonds have a maturity of five years and an interest rate of 14.5 percent per annum, the paper said.
The paper quoted Reliance officials as saying the issue would gradually establish a yield curve for the company's domestic issues.

The issue compared favourably to recent bond issues by other top-rated companies with the Industrial Credit and Investment Credit Corporation of India which raised bonds at 16.25 percent, the Economic Times quoted Reliance officials as saying.
